title: introduce-reservoir-stockpiler-and-deferred-sla-experiment
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: We see recurring hard-decommits and noisy SLA violations during cluster-wide reclaim windows. Operators requested a low-risk way to evaluate soft-reservation strategies and emergency capacity behaviors without altering live allocation logic. This PR introduces two related pieces: (1) a 'reservoir stockpiler' subsystem that allows the autoscaler to opportunistically accumulate short-lived capacity credits (stockpiles) for tenants when clusters are underutilized, and (2) a 'deferred SLA experiment' mode that runs a probabilistic simulator inside the control plane to evaluate headroom decay and eviction impacts before applying new autoscaling policies in production.

Summary of changes: single continuous description of code/docs/telemetry and operational tooling added: 1) Core controller: stockpiler manager for dedicated fleets that tracks per-tenant stockpile balance, stockpile decay curve, and redemption rules. 2) Simulator: a background component that replays sampled traffic traces against a configurable policy to estimate SLO violations, mean latency impact, and stockpile exhaustion percentiles. 3) Telemetry: new metrics (reservoir_level_bytes, reservoir_credits, reservoir_decay_rate, reservoir_redeem_success, simulator_predicted_95_latency_delta) and Grafana dashboards. 4) CLI/console controls: experiment toggle, visualization, and an API to export simulated scenarios for on-call review. 5) Safety: a non-invasive opt-in mode that never alters live scheduling decisions; subsequent PR will wire the conservative redemption policy into the live allocator after signoff.

Checklist:
- [x] Reservoir data model and APIs (Create/Consume/Decay)
- [x] Probabilistic replay simulator with scenario seeds and sample replay rate control
- [x] Telemetry + dashboards for stockpile health and simulator outputs
- [x] Unit and integration tests for stockpiler lifecycle
- [x] End-to-end e2e job that runs simulator against canned traces
- [x] Documentation: operator guide and short runbook for experiment adoption

Why this is different: existing autoscaler features control allocation and burst credits at request-time. The stockpiler is an opportunistic pre-allocation mechanism that acts like a short-lived escrow reserve: it captures transient spare capacity and presents it as redeemable credits during future surges. The simulator lets us probe long-tail failure modes (multi-tenant exhaustion, correlated evictions) under realistic workload replays, giving operators quantitative tradeoffs before changing live policies.

Commits summary:
- a1b3d8e: introduce stockpiler store and proto definitions (core types, retention)
- b7f4c2d: stockpiler manager implementation with decay scheduler and redemption hooks
- c3e9f0a: simulator: trace replayer and policy driver (with deterministic seeding)
- d22a7b9: add Prometheus metrics and dashboard JSONs; wire into console UI
- e9b517f: integration tests + e2e runner and sample traces
- f0a4c1b: docs: operator guide and runbook

Changed files (high level):
- src/autoscaler/stockpiler/{manager.go,store.go,types.proto,decay.go} - main logic
- src/autoscaler/simulator/{replayer.go,policy_driver.go,scenarios/} - simulator and sample traces
- src/controlplane/api/{reservoir_api.go,handlers_test.go} - experiment toggle endpoints
- observability/dashboards/reservoir-health.json - new dashboards
- telemetry/metrics.yaml - new metric families and labels
- docs/operator/reservoir-stockpiler.md - operator guide and runbook
- e2e/testdata/traces/reservoir-sample-1.json - sample trace
- tests/autoscaler/stockpiler_test.go - unit tests

Small illustrative diff snippets (kept minimal):
- types.proto: added message ReservoirBalance { string tenant_id = 1; uint64 credits = 2; double decay_rate = 3; int64 last_updated = 4; }
- manager.go: Redeem(ctx, tenant, requested) -> checks balance, applies fractional redemption with telemetry event reservoir_redeem_success{outcome}

Review conversation (selected):
- Jonah Kim (reviewer): "This is a big change surface; can we add a quick guard to ensure the stockpiler never increases a tenant's committed reservation? We should also bound memory usage for the store."
- Aisha Patel (author): "Agreed. Manager now enforces MaxReservoirPerTenant config and only issues credits with a non-binding label; added LRU eviction for old tenant entries. See commit b7f4c2d."
- Priya Rao (reviewer): "Simulator predictions look promising but I'm concerned about trace representativeness. Can we add a stratified sampler to the e2e job?"
- Aisha Patel: "Added stratified sampling by tenant size and request-rate buckets. Also included a small script to synthesize edge-case spikes (c3e9f0a)."
- Marcus Nguyen (reviewer): "Telemetry labels look noisy; please ensure cardinality is kept low for reservoir_level_bytes."
- Aisha Patel: "Changed label schema to tenant_tier rather than tenant_id where possible and added a cardinality note in telemetry/metrics.yaml."

CI summary: early runs failed on linter + race detector; fixes were pushed: tightened proto comments and fixed a concurrency bug in decay.go. Final run: unit tests 216 passed, 0 failed; integration suite (flaky) had 1 transient failure earlier but passed on rerun; coverage unchanged (+0.3%).

Operational notes and follow-ups (in PR body):
- Experiment lifecycle: operators enable via console -> select cluster -> enable 'deferred-sla-experiment' for a rolling window. The system will start collecting simulated outcomes and populate dashboards. No scheduling decisions are changed in this mode.
- If the simulator shows >5% predicted SLA regression at p95 for any tenant, a followup RFC/flag is required before auto-enablement.
- Next PR will wire an opt-in conservative redemption policy into the live allocator (safe_redeem mode) and add automated rollback hooks tied to simulator signals.

Merge outcome: merged on 2026-02-18 after approvals from all reviewers and a green CI run. Merge method: squash and merge.

Release notes: 
- Added experimental reservoir stockpiler for dedicated fleets (opt-in, non-invasive).
- Added probabilistic deferred-SLA simulator and related telemetry/dashboards.
- Operator docs and e2e traces included.

Breaking change: false
